articles.body:
Fetch the complete documentation index at: /llms.txt

Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

Copy page Copy MCP Server View as Markdown Models on Cerebras public endpoints are available on the free trial and pay-as-you-go tiers, subject to rate limits and pricing . For additional model families, reserved capacity, higher throughput, and production SLAs, see Dedicated Endpoints . New here? Follow the Quickstart to make your first API call. To pick a model by use case, see the model selection guide . Select any model name below for full specs, capabilities, and per-tier limits. ​ Available Models Model Name Model ID Parameters Context (free / paid) Speed (tokens/s) OpenAI GPT OSS gpt-oss-120b 120 billion 65k / 131k ~3000 Qwen 3.8 27B qwen-3.8-27b 27 billion 64k / 128k ~1500 Looking for more models? Many additional model families are available through Dedicated Endpoints . ​ Model Compression This section provides transparency about the compression state of each model available on our platform. We host a variety of open-source models from the community. We do not currently host pruned models on our public endpoints. All models served through our public endpoints are the original, unpruned versions. While we conduct research on pruning techniques like REAP (Router-weighted Expert Activation Pruning), these pruned models are shared with the research community on Hugging Face but are not available through our shared API. You can read more about REAP in our research blog . All of our public models are unpruned. Cerebras uses selective weight-only quantization only during storage to preserve maximal quality. This means that the weights are stored in partial 16-bit / 8-bit / 4-bit, in-line with industry standards. For quality, sensitive layers are stored at full precision with dequantization on the fly, so operations are done in high precision. The activations, attention, and kv cache remain in full precision and unquantized. ​ Frequently Asked Questions Will you change a model's architecture without notice?

Where can I find your REAP pruned models?

What are compression, quantization, and pruning?

Was this page helpful?
articles.bodyZh:
请到 /llms.txt 拉取完整的文档索引。

先看这个文件，把所有页面都摸清楚，再往下探索。

复制页面 复制 MCP 服务器 以 Markdown 形式查看

Cerebras 公共端点上的模型现在支持免费试用和按量付费两种套餐，具体会受到速率限制和价格的影响。如果你需要更多模型系列、预留容量、更高吞吐量以及生产级 SLA（服务等级协议），可以看看专用端点（Dedicated Endpoints）。

刚来的朋友？跟着快速上手（Quickstart）走一遍，就能发出你的第一个 API 请求。要是想按使用场景选模型，可以去看模型选择指南。下面点任意一个模型名称，就能看到完整规格、能力以及各套餐的限制。

可用模型

模型名称 模型 ID 参数量 上下文长度（免费 / 付费） 速度（token/秒） OpenAI
GPT-OSS gpt-oss-120b 1200亿 65k / 131k ~3000
Qwen 3.8 27B qwen-3.8-27b 270亿 64k / 128k ~1500

还想要更多模型？很多其他模型系列可以通过专用端点（Dedicated Endpoints）获取。

模型压缩

这部分是想让你清楚地知道，我们平台上每个模型的压缩状态是什么样的。我们托管了社区里的各种开源模型。目前，我们的公共端点上不托管剪枝（pruned）模型。所有通过公共端点提供的模型都是原始未剪枝版本。

虽然我们也在研究像 REAP（Router-weighted Expert Activation Pruning，即路由加权专家激活剪枝）这样的剪枝技术，但这些剪枝后的模型只会分享给 Hugging Face 上的研究社区，并不会通过我们的共享 API 提供。你可以在我们的研究博客里了解更多关于 REAP 的内容。

我们所有的公共模型都是未剪枝的。Cerebras 只在存储时使用选择性仅权重量化（weight-only quantization），以尽可能保持质量。也就是说，权重按照行业标准以部分 16 位 / 8 位 / 4 位的格式存储。为了保证质量，敏感层会以全精度存储，并在使用时动态反量化，所以运算过程都是高精度完成的。激活（activation）、注意力（attention）和 KV 缓存（kv cache）始终保持全精度，不做量化。

我去哪里找你那些 REAP 剪枝模型？

压缩、量化、剪枝分别是什么意思？

articles.title: The largest electric aircraft just flew [video]
articles.zh: The largest electric aircraft just flew [video]
articles.body:
History is littered with hundreds of conflicts over the future of a community, group, location or business that were "resolved" when one of the parties stepped ahead and destroyed what was there. With the original point of contention destroyed, the debates would fall to the wayside. Archive Team believes that by duplicated condemned data, the conversation and debate can continue, as well as the richness and insight gained by keeping the materials. Our projects have ranged in size from a single volunteer downloading the data to a small-but-critical site, to over 100 volunteers stepping forward to acquire terabytes of user-created data to save for future generations.

The main site for Archive Team is at archiveteam.org and contains up to the date information on various projects, manifestos, plans and walkthroughs.

This collection contains the output of many Archive Team projects, both ongoing and completed. Thanks to the generous providing of disk space by the Internet Archive, multi-terabyte datasets can be made available, as well as in use by the Wayback Machine , providing a path back to lost websites and work.

Our collection has grown to the point of having sub-collections for the type of data we acquire. If you are seeking to browse the contents of these collections, the Wayback Machine is the best first stop. Otherwise, you are free to dig into the stacks to see what you may find.

The Archive Team Panic Downloads are full pulldowns of currently extant websites, meant to serve as emergency backups for needed sites that are in danger of closing, or which will be missed dearly if suddenly lost due to hard drive crashes or server failures.
articles.bodyZh:
历史上，关于一个社区、团体、地点或生意的未来，发生过成百上千次冲突，而其中很多“解决”方式，就是某一方先下手为强，干脆把原有的东西给毁了。争论的焦点没了，争来争去也就没了意义。Archive Team（档案团队）相信，只要把那些被判了“死刑”的数据复制保存下来，对话和争论就能继续下去，那些材料里蕴含的丰富信息和深刻见解也不会丢失。我们的项目规模有大有小：有时候只有一个志愿者去下载某个小但重要的网站的数据；有时候则会有上百名志愿者一起动手，去抓取好几太字节（TB）的用户生成内容，把它们留给后人。

Archive Team 的主站在 archiveteam.org，上面有各种项目、宣言、计划和操作指南的最新信息。

这个合集收录了 Archive Team 许多项目的成果，既有正在进行中的，也有已经完成的。多亏了互联网档案馆（Internet Archive）慷慨提供磁盘空间，我们才能把这些多太字节级别的数据集保存下来，也让“时光机”（Wayback Machine）能用上它们，帮人们找回那些已经消失的网站和资料。

我们的收藏规模越来越大，甚至已经开始按数据类型细分成子合集了。如果你只是想浏览这些合集里的内容，最好先去“时光机”看看。当然，如果你想自己钻进去翻翻看，也完全没问题。

Archive Team 的“紧急下载”（Panic Downloads）是对现存网站的完整抓取，目的是给那些面临关闭风险、或者如果因硬盘损坏或服务器故障而突然消失会让人无比怀念的网站，留一份紧急备份。

articles.title: Headroom-Drift Replay: A Primitive for Principled Replay Control in GRPO
articles.zh: Headroom-Drift Replay: A Primitive for Principled Replay Control in GRPO
articles.author: Hyun Bin Park, Du-Seong Chang
articles.body: RL-based post-training for reasoning models is increasingly bottlenecked by repeated fresh rollout generation, particularly in agentic settings where environment interaction dominates wall-clock cost. Replay can reduce this burden by reusing past trajectories, but existing methods typically embed it within larger training pipelines involving exploration, experience restructuring, or mixed-policy optimization. This makes replay's own contribution difficult to isolate. We ask a focused question: how far can principled replay selection alone go? We introduce Headroom-Drift Replay, a group-level replay control primitive for GRPO that separates reuse into two decisions. Headroom ranks stored groups by remaining learning value, while Drift gates them by compatibility with the current policy. The fresh on-policy stream remains unchanged, and the method adds no auxiliary generation or training machinery. Across mathematical reasoning, multimodal reasoning, and Agentic Search benchmarks, this single intervention outperforms naive replay and matches or exceeds broader replay methods on Avg Mean@32. In Agentic Search, where environment interaction dominates cost, it delivers comparable quality at materially lower wall-clock time.
articles.bodyZh: 基于强化学习（RL）的推理模型后训练，正越来越受制于反复生成全新 rollout 数据的瓶颈——尤其是在智能体（agentic）场景里，跟环境交互才是真正吃掉大量实际运行时间（wall-clock time）的大头。重放（replay）机制可以通过复用过去的轨迹来缓解这个负担，但现有做法通常把重放嵌在更大的训练流程里，要么配着探索策略、要么做经验重构、要么搞混合策略优化，这样一来，重放本身到底起了多大作用就很难单独拎出来评估。我们只问一个聚焦的问题：单靠一套有原则的重放筛选机制，能做到什么程度？为此我们提出了 Headroom-Drift Replay，一个面向 GRPO 的组级别重放控制原语，把“复用”拆成两个独立决策：Headroom 负责给存下来的样本组按“剩余学习价值”排序，Drift 则负责把关，看这些旧样本跟当前策略还搭不搭。新鲜的在策略（on-policy）数据流完全不受影响，整个方法也不引入任何额外的生成或训练机制。在数学推理、多模态推理和智能体搜索（Agentic Search）等多个基准上，光是这一个干预，效果就超过了朴素重放，在 Avg Mean@32 指标上甚至能比肩或超越更复杂的重放方案。在环境交互占主导成本的 Agentic Search 场景里，它能在显著缩短实际运行时间的同时，交出质量相当的成绩。

articles.title: Masked Autoregressive Speech Enhancement with Continuous Neural Audio Codec Representations
articles.zh: Masked Autoregressive Speech Enhancement with Continuous Neural Audio Codec Representations
articles.author: Yoto Fujita, Simon Leglaive 等
articles.body: Most previous work on speech enhancement (SE) based on masked generative modeling relied on discrete token representations of audio signals, obtained using neural audio codecs (NACs). However, a recent study has shown that continuous latent representations of NACs can be advantageous for SE in terms of speech quality and intelligibility. In this work, we propose masked autoregressive SE (MARSE), a method for SE based on iterative decoding of masked clean speech frames using continuous NAC representations of speech. In particular, we investigate a set of different decoding policies, ceteris paribus, that is, using the same DNN (a Conformer model), the same NAC (the DAC codec) and the same training setup. The results show that MARSE enables a flexible trade-off between SE performance and computational cost. Audio examples and code are available online.
articles.bodyZh:
之前关于语音增强（SE，speech enhancement）的研究，大多是基于掩码生成式建模，用神经音频编解码器（NAC，neural audio codecs）把音频信号转换成离散的token来表示。但最近有研究发现，用NAC的连续潜变量表示来做语音增强，反而能在语音质量和可懂度上取得更好的效果。

基于这个思路，我们提出了MARSE——一种掩码自回归语音增强方法。它的核心思路是：利用语音的连续NAC表示，对带噪语音中被掩码的干净语音帧进行迭代解码，逐步还原出干净的语音。

在实验中，我们专门比较了不同的解码策略，但保持其他条件完全一致——用的是同一个深度神经网络（DNN，deep neural network）模型（即Conformer模型）、同一个NAC编解码器（即DAC codec）、以及完全相同的训练配置。

结果表明，MARSE可以在语音增强效果和计算开销之间灵活取舍，按需调节。相关音频示例和代码都已公开上线，欢迎查看。

articles.title: Towards Numerical TOHTN Planning with SMT-based HTN-SAT Encoding
articles.zh: Towards Numerical TOHTN Planning with SMT-based HTN-SAT Encoding
articles.author: Gaspard Quenard, Takudzwa Togarepi 等
articles.body: While HTN planning has received significant attention in recent years, support for numerical reasoning remains very limited. In this paper, we investigate numerical Totally-Ordered HTN (TOHTN) planning and show how standard SAT-based encodings can be naturally extended with SMT to handle numeric fluents. In addition, we introduce a benchmark suite for numerical TOHTN planning, providing a first common basis for evaluation in this setting. Experimental results show that this simple encoding already constitutes a competitive baseline. This work opens the way to more expressive approaches to HTN planning.
articles.bodyZh: 近年来，HTN规划（层次任务网络规划）虽然受到了不少关注，但在数值推理方面的支持却依然非常有限。这篇论文里，我们研究的是数值化的全序HTN规划（TOHTN），并且展示了如何把基于SAT（布尔可满足性）的标准编码方式，自然地扩展成用SMT（可满足性模理论）来处理数值流。另外，我们还搞了一套针对数值TOHTN规划的基准测试集，算是给这个方向提供了一个大家都能用的共同评估平台。实验结果表明，就这么个简单的编码，已经能构成一个有竞争力的基准线了。这项工作，算是为以后更丰富的HTN规划方法铺了条路。

articles.title: RATL: Learning from Retrieved Residuals for Robust Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
articles.zh: RATL: Learning from Retrieved Residuals for Robust Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
articles.author: Yuchen He, Yueyang Cang 等
articles.body: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) complements parametric models with retrieved external evidence. The same idea is attractive for continuous-output regression, but directly reusing retrieved target values is often not robust when samples differ in output level, numerical scale, or local dynamics. Moreover, conventional forecasting pipelines generally use residuals for model optimization and error diagnosis, but do not retain individual historical residual examples as memory that can be accessed at inference time.For multivariate time-series forecasting, we propose RATL, a plug-in residual-retrieval and feedback-correction method. RATL freezes a base forecaster to construct retrieval keys and turns its historical forecast residuals into a train-only memory specific to that base model. At inference time, RATL retrieves residual trajectories from similar historical contexts subject to causal availability constraints, then uses a set-aware router operating over forecast blocks and variables to select and combine these trajectories. Experiments show that historical residuals matched to the current context contain reusable forecasting information and that RATL improves frozen base forecasters in most experimental settings. Ablations further show that learned routing strengthens raw residual feedback, while validation-based correction-strength selection limits residual over-injection.On real-world benchmarks, we use iTransformer as the primary frozen base forecaster, compare against multiple strong forecasting baselines, and test transferability across backbones. The results show that RATL can further improve base-forecaster performance in most settings.Overall, RATL shifts the retrieved object from historical target values to base-model-specific historical forecast errors, providing a plug-in, residual-memory-based paradigm for learned feedback correction in continuous-output forecasting.
articles.bodyZh:
检索增强生成（RAG）这个思路，是靠把外部检索到的证据跟模型自身参数结合起来用。这个想法放到连续输出类的回归任务上，听起来也挺有吸引力，但你要是直接把检索到的目标值拿来用，往往不太稳——因为样本之间的输出水平、数值范围、局部动态都可能差很多。另外，传统的时间序列预测流程里，残差一般只用来优化模型、做误差诊断，并不会把每一条历史残差单独存下来，等到预测的时候再拿出来调用。

针对多变量时间序列预测，我们提出了一个叫RATL的方法，简单说就是一个即插即用的“残差检索+反馈修正”模块。RATL先把基础预测模型冻住不动，用它的输出去构造检索用的键（key），然后把模型在历史上产生的预测残差，变成一份只属于这个基础模型的训练专用记忆库。到了推理阶段，RATL会根据当前上下文，在保证因果可用性的前提下，从相似的历史情境中检索出对应的残差轨迹，再用一个能感知集合的路由器，按预测块（forecast block）和变量维度来挑选、组合这些轨迹，最终形成修正信号。

实验表明，从相似历史上下文里匹配出来的残差，确实包含了可复用的预测信息；而且RATL在大多数实验设置下都能提升被冻住的基础模型的表现。进一步的消融实验显示，靠学习出来的路由机制能增强原始残差反馈的效果，而基于验证集的修正强度选择，能防止残差被过度注入。

在真实数据集上，我们主要用iTransformer作为冻住的基础预测器，跟好几个强基线方法做了对比，还测试了把RATL迁移到其他骨干网络上的表现。结果显示，在大多数场景下，RATL都能让基础预测器进一步变强。

总的来说，RATL把“检索”的对象，从历史目标值换成了“针对特定基础模型的历史预测误差”。它为连续输出的预测任务提供了一种即插即用、基于残差记忆的学习式反馈修正新思路。

articles.title: Fixed Suffix Dependency Ratio: Quantifying the Dual-Track Mechanism of Gender Assignment in Latvian Loanwords
articles.zh: Fixed Suffix Dependency Ratio: Quantifying the Dual-Track Mechanism of Gender Assignment in Latvian Loanwords
articles.author: Yelingyun Zhang, Atis Kapenieks 等
articles.body: Existing research has repeatedly observed the tendency for English loanwords to cluster in the masculine gender across different recipient languages, yet the origin of this pattern remains difficult to determine, as fixed morphological rules and default assignments are frequently analysed together. This study proposes the Fixed Suffix Dependency Ratio (FSDR) to quantify the degree of reliance on fixed derivational suffixes across different genders, and to distinguish between morphological anchoring and free-choice in distribution. By examining 1,832 Latvian noun lemma types, the results reveal a significant FSDR asymmetry within the loanword system: feminine loanwords rely significantly more on fixed derivational suffixes, while masculine loanwords are more concentrated in the free-choice zone. This pattern exhibits loanword specificity and has become more pronounced in contemporary usage. FSDR therefore provides a quantitative framework for testing default gender and shows how masculine default can be activated and reinforced under language contact.
articles.bodyZh:
现有研究反复观察到一种现象：英语外来词在不同接纳语言里，似乎总是更容易被归入阳性（masculine）性别。可这个模式究竟怎么来的，一直不太好说，因为固定的形态规则和默认分配常常被混在一起分析。为了把这两件事拆开，本研究提出了一个叫“固定后缀依赖度”（Fixed Suffix Dependency Ratio, FSDR）的指标，用来量化不同性别在多大程度上依赖固定的派生后缀，借此区分“形态锚定”和“自由选择”这两种分布。

通过分析1832个拉脱维亚语名词词条，结果显示外来词系统内部存在明显的FSDR不对称：阴性（feminine）外来词更依赖固定派生后缀，而阳性外来词则更多集中在“自由选择区”。这种模式是外来词特有的，而且在当代用法里变得更加突出。

因此，FSDR为检验默认性别提供了一个量化分析框架，也能说明在语言接触中，阳性默认机制是如何被激活、被强化的。

articles.title: Speak for Me: Giving LLMs the Situational Awareness to Participate in a Meeting
articles.zh: Speak for Me: Giving LLMs the Situational Awareness to Participate in a Meeting
articles.author: Muneeb Khan, Frederic Kirstein 等
articles.body: In online meeting delegation, LLM agents fail to recognize when to speak. With no structured way to track stances, coverage, and floor, they miss the moments where they should contribute. Prompt-only delegates stay silent on 51.4% of the absent participant's talking opportunities on the AMI corpus. We present CAPA (Collaborative Agent Predictive Architecture), an architecture for online meeting delegation. A Perceiver updates the meeting state from each observed turn. A Predictor forecasts how the conversation will continue. A Controller decides whether to speak and which proposition to surface. A Generator phrases the chosen contribution in the participant's style. Two judges score the forecast and the action against the next observed turn. A Recalibrator updates the meeting state from those verdicts for future decisions. To evaluate online delegation, we introduce an episode-level protocol that scores whether, when, and what a delegate contributes around the participant's actual idea units. The protocol's schema-constrained LLM judges align with human annotations at Cohen's kappa = 0.71. On 137 AMI meetings, CAPA reduces the silence rate from 51.4% to 2.5%, doubles credited recovery (26.1 --> 52.2), and keeps hallucination at 0.6%. The failure mode shifts from omission to selection, with each residual near-miss attributable to a specific module of the architecture. Mechanism ablations identify the meeting state as the lever that closes the recognition gap, where raw-context scaling alone does not.
articles.bodyZh:
在线上会议代开场景里，大语言模型（LLM）代理常常把握不好该什么时候开口。因为它们没有一套结构化的机制来追踪各方立场、话题覆盖范围和发言权归属，该插话的时机往往被白白错过。在AMI语料库（多模态会议语料库）上，纯靠提示词驱动的代理在缺席参会者原本该发言的机会里，有51.4%的时间选择沉默。

我们提出了CAPA（协作式代理预测架构，Collaborative Agent Predictive Architecture），专门用于线上会议代开任务。它有几个核心模块：感知器（Perceiver）根据每一轮观察到的发言更新会议状态；预测器（Predictor）推断对话接下来会怎么走；控制器（Controller）决定要不要开口、要抛出哪个观点；生成器（Generator）按照参会者本人的说话风格把选中的观点组织成话术。此外，还有两个评判器（Judge）会根据下一轮真实发言，给预测结果和实际动作打分；最后，校准器（Recalibrator）依据这些打分结果反向更新会议状态，以便后续做出更合理的决策。

为了评估线上代开的效果，我们设计了一套“回合级别”的评测协议，专门检查代开代理是否在参会者真实观点单位出现的节点上，正确地回答了“说没说、什么时候说、说的是什么”这三个问题。这套协议里采用结构化约束的大语言模型评判器与人工标注的结果高度一致，Cohen's kappa系数达到0.71。

在137场AMI会议上，CAPA把沉默率从51.4%降到了2.5%，被认可的“补救式发言”比例翻了一倍（从26.1提升到52.2），同时幻觉率保持在0.6%。失败模式也从“该说不说”变成了“选择不够精准”，每一个残余的近失错误都可以追溯到架构里的某个具体模块。对机制进行消融实验后发现，真正弥合“开口时机识别缺口”的关键杠杆是会议状态本身，单纯堆长原始上下文并不能解决问题。

articles.title: Value-Preserving Architectures for Agentic AI Systems
articles.zh: Value-Preserving Architectures for Agentic AI Systems
articles.author: Alessandro Pesare, Tommaso Dolci 等
articles.body: The emergence of agentic AI and LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) presents unprecedented opportunities for automating complex tasks, while simultaneously raising critical concerns about the preservation of fundamental human-centered values, such as privacy, fairness, and safety. Although software engineering has traditionally focused on functional correctness, the adoption of LLMs and AI agents into complex socio-technical systems has intensified the need for responsible software engineering and robust value alignment. In MAS, architectural design decisions, such as coordination mechanisms, communication protocols, and system topologies, play a central role in shaping system behavior and the outcomes they produce. This paper argues that architectural choices influence not only the functionality and performance of MAS but can also promote value-oriented system behavior. Therefore, we investigate how different architectural designs support different human-centered values, discussing the following value-preserving architectural patterns: (i) a privacy-aware architecture with a federated topology, (ii) a distributed architecture to promote pluralism and diversity, and (iii) a guard-agent architecture to detect and mitigate unfairness. Finally, we introduce representative use cases to illustrate the proposed architectures in real-world scenarios. By linking architectural design with human-centered values, this work lays the foundation for a unified set of architectural patterns and guidelines towards the design of trustworthy MAS.
articles.bodyZh:
代理型AI（agentic AI）和基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（multi-agent systems, MAS）正在崛起，这为自动化处理复杂任务带来了前所未有的机遇，但与此同时，它也引发了一个让人不得不重视的问题：我们如何在这种系统里守住那些以人为本的核心价值，比如隐私、公平和安全？过去，软件工程主要盯着功能对不对、跑得通不通，但随着LLM和AI代理被大量引入复杂的社会技术系统（socio-technical systems），我们越来越需要在软件开发中强调“负责任”和“价值对齐”（value alignment）。

在多智能体系统里，架构设计的决策——比如协调机制、通信协议、系统拓扑结构——在很大程度上决定了系统会表现出什么行为、最终产生什么结果。这篇文章的核心论点就是：架构选择不只是影响系统的功能和性能，它还能推动系统走向更符合人类价值观的行为方式。基于这个视角，我们研究了不同的架构设计如何支撑不同的人类价值观，并提出了三种能够守护价值的架构模式：第一，带有联邦拓扑（federated topology）的隐私感知架构；第二，用来促进多元性和多样性的分布式架构；第三，用来发现并抑制不公平现象的“守护代理”（guard-agent）架构。最后，我们还给出了一些有代表性的实际用例，来说明这些架构在真实场景中是怎么落地的。

通过把架构设计和人类价值观连在一起，这项研究为未来设计值得信赖的多智能体系统打下了一个基础，目标是逐步形成一套统一的架构模式和设计指南。

articles.title: RuleMem: Active Rule Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
articles.zh: RuleMem: Active Rule Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
articles.author: Xingyuan Zeng, Zuohan Wu 等
articles.body: Question answering agents in long-term conversations must reason over massive, temporally dispersed dialogue histories. However, existing memory mechanisms primarily treat past information as \textit{passively} stored facts, leading to semantic gaps and unreliable reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose RuleMem, a rule-based memory framework that induces reusable logical rules from historical interactions to \textit{actively} guide both evidence retrieval and reasoning. Specifically, RuleMem constructs natural-language Horn clauses from conversations and validates them via a Rule Perplexity Consistency (RPC) mechanism. These induced rules enable the retrieval of semantically distant evidence while providing an explicit logical structure for answer generation. We conducted a comprehensive evaluation of RuleMem on two long-term conversational benchmarks, LoCoMo and LongMemEval_s*. In a rigorous comparison against 14 baselines on LoCoMo, RuleMem achieved the highest accuracy, exceeding the baseline average by 27.47 points (a 54.3% relative improvement).
articles.bodyZh: 长期对话里的问答系统，得在海量而且时间拉得很长的对话历史中做推理。但现有的记忆机制，大多只是把过去的信息当成“被动存着的事实”，结果就是语义上有断层，推理也容易不靠谱。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 RuleMem——一个基于规则的记忆框架。它会从历史交互里提炼出可以反复使用的逻辑规则，再用这些规则去“主动”引导证据检索和推理。具体来说，RuleMem 会先把对话内容整理成自然语言形式的霍恩子句（Horn clauses），然后用一个叫“规则困惑度一致性”（Rule Perplexity Consistency，RPC）的机制来验证这些规则。这样得来的规则，既能帮我们找到那些语义上隔得比较远、但确实相关的证据，又能给答案生成提供一个清晰的逻辑结构。我们分别在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval_s* 这两个长期对话基准上，对 RuleMem 做了全面的测试。在 LoCoMo 上，我们跟 14 个基线方法做了严格对比，RuleMem 的准确率最高，比基线的平均成绩高出 27.47 个百分点，也就是相对提升了 54.3%。
